verdict.rationale: sevDesk documents one in-product suggestion feature: automatic booking-category suggestions, plus automatic asset recognition from expense receipts. Neither is described as AI-generated, and both are narrow automations rather than broad insights. The dashboard and BWA reports are standard reporting, not AI insights. Missing for 10: explicit AI/ML-generated insights, analytical suggestions or recommendations drawn from business data, documentation of how suggestions are generated, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Receive a suggestion for the right booking category automatically.
Your assets are automatically recognised from expense receipts and depreciated correctly
